_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Jupiter Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: CSB-hosted Edge/Edge+ T&C (PDF created 5 Sep 2026), Redemption Slabs: 1 Jewel = ₹0.20 when redeemed for Jupiter Flights, Jupiter Store, Brand Vouchers or Digital Gold; 1 Jewel = ₹0.14 for Statement Credit, Bill Payments or Cash/Cash-equivalent. Baseline uses the lower, cash-equivalent value. Jupiter or the bank may change the rates; the app shows the rate at redemption. Jewels do not expire except after 365 days of card inactivity or 90 days of unpaid dues. Re-confirmed 2026-11-07 against the Jupiter-hosted T&C (page modified 15 Oct 2026), which states the same two values.

open_questions: Earn rule as CSB's documents define it (re-read 2026-11-07): the CSB-hosted T&C, section 3a (PDF created 5 Sep 2026), says the Edge+ RuPay card "offers rewards in the form of Jewels only for transactions on the Jupiter UPI App", i.e. UPI Intent, UPI Scan & Pay and UPI Collect made with the Edge+ RuPay card, and that "transactions made by linking the Edge+ CSB Rupay Card to other UPI Apps will not be eligible for rewards". The T&C names no Jewel earn on swipe, tap, chip or online card-details payments with the RuPay card, so none is drafted (the FAQ on Jupiter's Edge+ page says the RuPay card "is built for UPI" and "The Mastercard add-on is for card transactions (online and in-store) only"). Jewel rates for transactions that qualify: 5% Jewels on all other eligible spend; 50% Jewels on the ten listed shopping brands only if that statement cycle's qualified spend is above ₹15,000, otherwise 5% (5% credited instantly; the other 45% credited at cycle end only if the cycle's qualified spend is above ₹15,000, otherwise cancelled); 25% Jewels on Jupiter Flights. The MITC (25 Aug 2026) gives no rates. The CSB page headline "10% / 5% / 1% cashback ... on all online & offline spends" does not conflict: it matches 50 / 25 / 5 Jewels per ₹100 at ₹0.20 each, and the same page says "Scan with UPI, Pay with Credit Card". Reward unit: no document says in words that "X% Jewels" means X Jewels per ₹100 spent; that reading is the one that reproduces the headline cashback percentages (CSB page) and the Jupiter Edge+ page FAQ ("up to ₹2,000 monthly on shopping (10% rate)", i.e. the 10,000-Jewel category cap at ₹0.20), so it is used but stays flagged.

Jewel value (confirmed 2026-11-07): the CSB-hosted T&C (3A Redemption Slabs, PDF created 5 Sep 2026) and the Jupiter-hosted T&C (page modified 15 Oct 2026) both state 1 Jewel = Re. 0.20 for Jupiter Flights, Jupiter Store, Brand Vouchers and Digital Gold and 1 Jewel = Re. 0.14 for Statement Credit, Bill Payments and Cash/Cash Equivalent withdrawals; Jupiter's rewards page (modified 29 Jun 2026) and Edge+ page (modified 24 Jul 2026) show the same as 100 Jewels = ₹20 and ₹14. One outlier: the FAQ on the Edge+ page says "You can redeem 5 Jewels for ₹1 as cash, Digital Gold, or to pay your bills", which would make cash ₹0.20; it is the oldest text and the T&C prevails. Baseline uses ₹0.14 (0.7% on the 5-Jewel base rate); at ₹0.20 the rates equal the page headline 10% shopping, 5% travel and 1% other. The T&C says the app shows the applicable rate at redemption and the rates can change.

Rates changed in October 2026 and the two T&C texts disagree. CSB-hosted T&C (PDF created 5 Sep 2026, Last-Modified 7 Sep 2026): the old structure applies "till 04th October, 2026" (shopping 50% always, travel capped at 5,000 Jewels per cycle) and the updated one "from 05th October, 2026" (shopping 50% only when cycle spend is above ₹15,000, else 5%; travel 25% with no maximum listed). Jupiter-hosted copy of the T&C (page metadata modified 15 Oct 2026, so newer than CSB's PDF; it also adds the Mastercard add-on): old structure "till 30th Sep, 2026", updated from "10th October, 2026", and travel stays capped at 5,000 Jewels per statement cycle. The shopping and "Others" rules are identical in both. Used: the CSB-hosted PDF (the issuer's own document; effective 5 Oct 2026, travel uncapped), with the newer Jupiter-hosted text flagged. If the Jupiter text is the live one, Jupiter Flights earn would stop at 5,000 Jewels (₹20,000 of flights) per cycle. CSB's PDF shows no change since its HTTP Last-Modified of 7 Sep 2026. Action: confirm in the Jupiter app T&C screen or with CSB which text governs the travel cap.

Shopping merchant cap 3,000 Jewels and transaction-level cap 1,000 Jewels per statement cycle are in the T&C; the schema has no per-transaction period, so the 1,000 sits in the rule conditions and only the 10,000 category cap and 3,000 merchant cap are cap rows. What earns after a cap is hit is not stated; downgrade to the 5-Jewel rate is assumed.

Joining fee (re-checked 2026-11-07): ₹999 + GST for the Edge+ RuPay card in the MITC (updated 25 Aug 2026, uploaded 30 Oct 2026) and the KFS (5 Nov 2025); the CSB page says ₹499 "for first 2 lakh users"; Jupiter's Edge+ page (modified 24 Jul 2026) says ₹0 as a "limited period offer; regular ₹999". The MITC is the newest dated document and states ₹999, which is used; the ₹499 and ₹0 are undated promotions with no end date given. Annual fee is nil in all of them.

Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% with a maximum of ₹100, on spends of ₹400 to ₹3,000 (MITC footnote); the period for the ₹100 maximum is not stated, so monthly_waiver_cap_inr is null. The page-level surcharge is ₹10 up to ₹400 and 1% above.

Insurance and concierge benefit (personal accident and total permanent disability up to ₹2 lakh, 24/7 concierge) is "limited to Platinum Variant Card (BIN 653038)"; whether Edge+ RuPay is that BIN is not stated, so it is not modelled.

The MITC covers three cards (Edge CSB RuPay joining nil; Edge+ CSB RuPay ₹999; Edge+ CSB Mastercard ₹999 with nil forex). This draft is the Edge+ RuPay card only. The non-plus Edge card (flat 2% Jewels, ₹250 welcome voucher) is a separate product not in the catalogue.
Rounding mode and the Jewel crediting delay are not stated. Minimum redemption threshold is shown in the Jupiter app, not in the documents.
notes: Card replacement ₹249. Interest 3.75% a month (45% a year), interest-free period 13 to 47 days. EMI processing ₹99 or 1% of the converted amount, whichever is higher; foreclosure 3% of remaining principal. Overlimit transactions are not allowed. Jewels earned in a cycle are locked and earning pauses while the minimum amount due is unpaid.
Held in the earlier pass for lack of a reward rate; the rates are now stated in the CSB-hosted T&C, so the card can be imported once the open questions above are cleared.

Edge+ Mastercard add-on (Jupiter-hosted T&C, not in the CSB PDF): once a customer has the Mastercard add-on, the RuPay card's travel benefit "will cease" and moves to the Mastercard (25% Jewels on Jupiter Flights and Hotels, cap 7,500 Jewels per statement cycle, 5% on others, no Jewels on forex spends). Not modelled: the Mastercard is a separate card on a shared limit.
